sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A European annual bugloss, usually 15–60 cm tall and rough with stiff hairs. Its alternate leaves are narrow; small blue, occasionally white flowers have a curved tube and unequal lobes. Each flower produces four rough nutlets. It grows in crops, sandy ground and disturbed sites and is naturalised elsewhere.

sections.title: Food and safety
sections.text: Pyrrolizidine alkaloids have been detected in plant extracts, but the sources consulted establish no edible part and do not support a general statement about ingestion risk.
